title: Avoid cloning shared message bodies for discard-only removals
outcome: Discard-only transcript removal does not copy a shared body while StateInner is held, and retained snapshots keep their original contents.
acceptance: The remote-delta and state-cleanup removal paths discard message bodies without converting shared bodies to owned copies, while preserving live message ordering and retained snapshot contents.
A focused regression keeps a shared snapshot alive during production discard-only removal, observes zero shared-body ownership clones, and verifies the live and snapshot contents.
